name: darkest_den
comment: Den of Evil arena: a round grotto, made like the Mausoleum's hall ('circle'): one of the game's four-way cave rooms (cavensew, 24x24 tiles) turned into an open round cave of radius 11, ringed with cave rocks, with walls along its edge so the automap shows the boundary (cave rooms have no straight walls, so they come from a cave theme room: 'wall_from'). The waypoint stands at the west edge (tile 3,12); the fight comes from the east. (Before 0.13.1 the Den was a copy of the Pit level 2 room, which the Pit stop still uses: src/maps/pit.json.)
